A.Project Description
The Cityof Cheyenne, Wyomingis seeking qualification statements and service proposals from
Expansionto the existing facility located at220College Drive, Cheyenne, Wyoming.The proposals
should be designed to provide the City with a clear understanding of the scope of work to be
completed.The specific nature of the scope of workfor the project is outlined in this Request for
Proposals (RFP). Consultants responding will be evaluated and a short list developed for formal
interviews to be conducted at a later date.A schedule for Consultant selection and project
completion is attached.Such proposals shall be submitted to the City of Cheyenne's Purchasing
Office,2101O'Neil Ave., Cheyenne, Wyoming by3:00 pm on Wednesday, April1,2015
I.Introduction and Background
The Cityof Cheyenne is currently designing an expansion to the Happy Jack Landfill and
reinstating acceptance of Municipal Solid Waste (MSW).An expansion at Happy Jack
Landfill also necessitates an expansion of the City of Cheyenne's Transfer Station.The
transfer facility was built in1985 to facilitate economical transport ofwasteto the Happy
Jack Landfill.The transfer station accepts MsW, household hazardous waste, electronic
waste, yard waste and other miscellaneous waste.The City has10%design documents for
the Transfer Station expansion.Because of significant cost involved in a Transfer Station
expansion, the City has separated theproject into smaller phases.The Cityhas completed
phase one, which included a Household Hazardous Waste Building, removing and relocating
shown inthe10% design documents.The Cityis nowready todesign the second and third
phases of the expansion.Phase two will update the existing Transfer Station andatwo story
addition to the front exteriorfor additional clerical staff.Phase three will expand existing
Transfer station to include new tipping floors in addition to a tire, oil and lube bays to
accommodate collection vehicles.
Consultant will be asked to:
Present Building design options for the City's consideration.
Prepare a full design of Phase2&3.
Prepare, submit, and acquire the needed permission and or permits from WD EQ to
remodel and expand the existing Transfer Station.
Consultant must have experience in the design of Transfer Stations andaworking knowledge
of Transfer Station Systems.
